Everyday dentistry

White fillings

A natural-looking way to restore a damaged tooth.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

Composite fillings can restore areas affected by decay or damage. The material is selected to blend with the surrounding tooth. Your dentist will assess the tooth and discuss suitable materials before treatment.

What to expect

  1. Examine the tooth and discuss the options.
  2. Prepare the area and place the chosen filling.
  3. Check the bite and explain how to care for the restoration.

A common question

Can an old filling be replaced?

A dentist can assess the condition of an existing filling and whether replacement would be appropriate. A sound filling does not automatically need changing.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
